description: The CT Cranium DICOM dataset is already loaded. Navigate to three specific anatomical levels and export a screenshot of the slice view for each: (1) Axial view of the orbits (eye sockets) -> /home/ga/Documents/axial_orbits.png; (2) Sagittal midline view (showing nasal cavity/brainstem) -> /home/ga/Documents/sagittal_midline.png; (3) Coronal view of the petrous temporal bones (ear region) -> /home/ga/Documents/coronal_petrous.png. Use the 'Export picture' function. Ensure the relevant anatomy is clearly visible in each export.
